look: Chalk geometry: a dark maths-explainer look (3Blue1Brown-style): clean vector dots, arrows and grids drawn in glowing strokes on a dark ground, shapes morphing smoothly, short serif captions

scenes.name: Dots to skin
scenes.desc: A 3D cloud of dots shaped like a person turns slowly; the title appears.

scenes.name: 1 The problem
scenes.desc: Zoom into the cloud: loose dots, no connections, no inside or outside; the goal is a skin of triangles.

scenes.name: 2 Inside or outside
scenes.desc: A grid of cells fills the space; cells inside turn 1, outside 0; the border between them is the skin.

scenes.name: 3 Arrows
scenes.desc: Outward arrows grow on the dots; walking through the skin, the 0 to 1 jump lines up with the arrows.

scenes.name: 4 One tile each
scenes.desc: One dot gathers its 24 neighbours, a flat tile fits them, the arrow sticks out; repeated for every dot, sign unknown.

scenes.name: 5 Make them agree
scenes.desc: A tree of safe links passes the direction dot to dot, flipping disagreeing arrows; a vote turns them all outward.

scenes.name: 6 Onto the grid
scenes.desc: Each arrow is shared among the grid corners around it, giving an arrow field on the grid.

scenes.name: 7 Rebuild chi
scenes.desc: One row of 8 cells: arrows give the changes, adding them up gives chi like stair heights; then the full map is solved by guess-and-improve, coarse to fine.

scenes.name: 8 Pins
scenes.desc: The soft step-7 edge sits off the dots; pins at the dots snap it into place; an alpha slider shows pin strength and the accuracy gain.

scenes.name: 9 Draw the skin
scenes.desc: Zoom into the skin: corners get chi values and turn blue or white; a probe walks one edge to the 0.5 point; every crossing edge gets its point; points join into the outline; then a cube splits into pyramids that give 1 or 2 triangles.

scenes.name: 10 Trim
scenes.desc: The closed outline bridges a gap with no dots; far segments are cut away, or kept for a printable version.

scenes.name: The pipeline
scenes.desc: All ten steps in one line, ending on the finished mesh numbers.
